third-party-3xui-live.description: The live 3X-UI adapter surface against an isolated real panel. Required tests are the ones the panel-backed launcher can actually satisfy. The two fail2ban probes are listed here AND waived below: a waiver only attaches to an item the profile already requires, so naming them N/A without requiring them left the waiver inert and the tests reported as UNEXPECTED rather than as N/A. They need a separate fail2ban endpoint the panel image does not run, so they skip — and a silent skip would read as coverage.

TestLive_Fail2banStatus.reason: needs a fail2ban endpoint the 3X-UI image does not run; not part of the panel-backed surface

third-party-sui-live.description: The live S-UI adapter surface against an isolated real panel. S-UI exposes one live entry point; the note in docs/compat/3x-ui-v4.json is that its FLOOR is unestablished, which is a different claim from its surface working.
